details.summary:
Shivagange Sunrise Trek – A Thrilling Climb to the Sacred Hill

Rising near Tumakuru, Shivagange is a distinctive hill destination where trekking and spirituality come together. Closely associated with Lord Shiva, the hill is surrounded by temples and sacred landmarks that give the journey a unique character.

The route takes you through rocky paths, stone steps and steeper sections as you make your way towards the upper reaches of the hill. Along the climb, natural surroundings blend with historic religious sites, making the experience about more than simply reaching the summit.

Reaching the top in the early morning offers a peaceful setting to watch the day begin. From the higher sections, trekkers can enjoy expansive views across the surrounding landscape while experiencing the changing atmosphere from the quiet trail to the open summit.

With approximately 8 km of trekking and a moderate difficulty level, Shivagange offers a more demanding sunrise adventure for travellers with a reasonable level of fitness. The combination of steep stretches, rocky terrain and spiritual surroundings creates a rewarding morning in the hills.

Whether you're looking for an active weekend challenge or want to experience a hill where nature and spirituality meet, Shivagange offers a memorable escape from Bengaluru.

itinerary.title: Bengaluru to Shivagange
itinerary.description: Your Shivagange sunrise adventure begins late at night as you leave Bengaluru and travel towards the sacred hill near Tumakuru.

activities.title: Board Vehicle
activities.description: Meet your trip coordinator at the designated pickup point and board the vehicle for your journey towards Shivagange. Sit back, relax and get comfortable for the overnight journey.

activities.title: Early Morning | Arrive at Shivagange Base
activities.description: Reach the designated base area and prepare for the trek. After a short briefing from your trek leader, get your headlamp or torch ready and prepare to begin the climb.

activities.title: Early Morning | Begin the Trek
activities.description: Start your ascent towards the Shivagange summit. The route combines rocky stretches, stone steps and steeper sections as you gradually gain elevation.

activities.title: Before Sunrise | Approach the Summit
activities.description: As the sky begins to brighten, continue towards the higher sections of the hill. The surrounding landscape slowly comes into view as you near the summit.

activities.title: Sunrise | Reach the Summit
activities.description: Reach the summit and settle in for the highlight of your Shivagange Sunrise Trek. Enjoy the morning light across the countryside, take photographs and spend some time experiencing the peaceful hilltop surroundings.

activities.title: Morning | Explore the Summit
activities.description: Explore the spiritual landmarks around the hilltop and take in the surrounding views before beginning the return journey.

activities.title: Begin the Descent
activities.description: Start your descent with the trek leader. Take care on the rocky and stepped sections as you make your way back towards the base.

activities.title: Trek Ends
activities.description: Reach the base after completing the trek and take some time to rest and freshen up.

activities.title: Breakfast Stop
activities.description: Stop at a local restaurant or en-route eatery for breakfast. Breakfast is self-sponsored.

activities.title: Return to Bengaluru
activities.description: Board the vehicle and begin your journey back to Bengaluru.

activities.title: Bengaluru Drop
activities.description: Arrive back in Bengaluru and conclude your Shivagange Sunrise Trek experience.

sections.title: A Trek Where Adventure Meets Spirituality
sections.body:
Shivagange is not only a trekking destination but also a sacred hill associated with Lord Shiva. Temples and spiritual landmarks are found along the route, adding cultural depth to the climb.

The rocky trail, stone steps and steep sections make the ascent engaging, while the hilltop opens up to broad countryside views. This combination of physical challenge, sacred surroundings and early-morning scenery gives Shivagange its distinctive trekking experience.

sections.title: Things to carry
sections.body:
Things to Carry for Shivagange Trek

(Since the trek begins during the early hours, packing the right essentials is important.)

[Must Carry]
• Small trekking backpack
• At least 2 litres of drinking water
• Headlamp or torch
• Trekking shoes with good grip
• Light jacket or windcheater
• Extra pair of socks
• Cap
• Sunglasses
• Sunscreen
• Energy bars or dry fruits
• Personal medication

• Fully charged mobile phone
• Power bank
• Valid government-issued ID

[During Monsoon]
• Rain jacket or poncho
• Waterproof backpack cover
• Waterproof phone pouch
• Extra clothes and socks

Packing Tip

Keep your backpack light. Avoid carrying unnecessary items as you'll be walking for several hours over uneven terrain.

sections.title: Trail guidelines
sections.body:
Shivagange is a natural and sacred hill destination with rocky and steep sections. Help preserve the surroundings and respect the spiritual sites.

"Trek Responsibly. Respect the Hills."

• Follow your trek leader's instructions at all times.
• Follow local rules and restrictions where applicable.
• Stay with the group throughout the trek.
• Remain on the designated trekking trail.
• Do not litter.
• Carry all waste back with you.
• Avoid single-use plastic.
• Do not smoke or consume alcohol during the trek.
• Do not light fires or campfires.
• Do not disturb wildlife.
• Do not damage plants or historical/religious structures.
• Be careful around steep, rocky and stepped sections.
• Avoid standing too close to edges while taking photographs.
• Wear appropriate trekking footwear.
• Stay hydrated throughout the trek.
• Take breaks whenever required.
• Avoid loud music that may disturb wildlife, fellow trekkers and visitors.
• Be cautious around monkeys and do not feed or provoke them.

"Leave Only Footprints. Take Only Memories."
